protocol.normalization: tanh on both indicator pairs; MACD line/histogram first divide by causal SMA14 true range; raw state retained, only log price z-normalized
protocol.source: SPYUSDT close, original-volume SPY V and Composite Strength from SPY+QQQ taker NetFlow
protocol.target: same exact next eight M15 closes wholly inside NY RTH, anchor last closed SPY close
protocol.split: reuse original path study 50/20/30 chronological target-day boundaries; no selection by final test; this archive has already been inspected, so exploratory not new untouched evidence
protocol.ema: SMA seeds for EMA12/26; EMA9 of MACD; histogram=MACD-signal. Never reset at session, advance on observed bars. Same causal 14-TR mean for normalization. Drop first34 warm-up bars and every non-finite 16-bar candidate identically for all variants.
protocol.ablation: Common log price, WLR width/slope/R2; remove all Price×SPY V candle-cluster channels from clean comparisons. PAIR adds tanh(SPY V), tanh(Composite). MACD adds tanh(MACD/ATR), tanh(histogram/ATR). Combined splits same30% indicator budget across4. PRICE control normalizes70% common weights to100%. ORIGINAL unchanged ten-channel STUMPY is a separate reference.
protocol.purge: same NY decision minute; all candidate targets completed before sixteen-bar query start; max20 non-overlap, one/day; identical cases/timestamps for all models
protocol.metric: primary eight-step path MAE% vs clean PAIR of same input length; endpoint MAE%, direction Brier/accuracy secondary. Percent frequencies add one pseudo-count per class; uncalibrated.
protocol.multiplicity: Two predeclared MACD-vs-PAIR primary comparisons (8 and16): 97.5% intervals each, Bonferroni familywise5%. Combined is secondary, unadjusted95%. Intervals use5000 paired five-day block bootstrap draws. No parameter or channel-weight tuning after test.
protocol.chart: research only; does not replace indicators or AUTO forecast selection
